# Which pip-audit findings does your code actually import?

> Paste pip-audit -f json and your Python source: see which vulnerable packages your code actually imports and which are test-only or unreferenced noise. Free pip-audit triage, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/pip-audit-triage/)
- [How to triage pip-audit findings without ignoring real risk](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/pip-audit-triage/how-to-triage-pip-audit-findings.html)
